cases.title: An ambiguous dispatch is never retried elsewhere
cases.when: The connection resets after DISPATCH is sent for a NON_IDEMPOTENT tool
then: The Gateway queries Control; if claimed it collects the outcome; if unclaimed after exp it retries with a new permit

cases.title: A host crash after ADMITTED ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
cases.when: The host process is killed after ADMITTED for a ledger tool, and for an idempotent tool
then: Ledger: lease expiry, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, no retry

cases.title: A Gateway crash does not duplicate execution
cases.when: The Gateway crashes after dispatch; the client retries on another replica with the same key
then: One execution; the retry returns EXISTING or the task

cases.title: A client re-issue matches the existing invocation
cases.when: A client re-sends with a new JSON-RPC id and the same idempotency key, and within the dedupe window without a key
then: No second invocation for non-idempotent tools

cases.title: REFUSED is retried on another host
then: Retry elsewhere with a new permit for both classes

cases.title: Reconcile answers update OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
cases.when: A tool with @Reconcile ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; reconcile answers APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED and UNKNOWN in three runs
then: Outcome updated with evidence; "effectively once" only with commit evidence
NOT_APPLIED re-execution only on opt-in, same key, new invocationId linked in audit

cases.title: Tools without reconcile are never re-executed
cases.when: A tool without the hook ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: The broker records evidence for each request
cases.when: A ledger tool sends a request that times out
then: Route, status and upstream request id are recorded and attached to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: The packager warns about retry libraries
cases.when: A NON_IDEMPOTENT tool configures a known retry library
